h1: Founded in Scotland. Built for the AI era.
lede: Purview Services Limited is a UK-headquartered technology group of 14 companies and 2,500 people across 21 countries, held together by one engineering standard.

blocks.text: Say yes only to work we can be proud of, then finish it

Purview started in Edinburgh over seventeen years ago as an IT services firm with that one rule. It earned long relationships with some of the world's largest banks, carriers and governments, and those relationships pulled the group into AI, payments, healthcare, networks and, most recently, the data centres that AI runs in.

Today the group builds the intelligent applications enterprises and governments run their business on, and the AI infrastructure those applications run on. Most technology companies do one or the other. Purview does both, and has for 17 years: one technology partner, from application to infrastructure.

"We are not a software company that happens to sell hardware, or an integrator that resells someone else's stack. A Purview engagement starts with a problem nobody has solved cleanly and ends with something installed, certified and operating at your site."
Senior leadership is involved from kick-off to handover on every engagement. These are the people accountable for the group's six verticals and fourteen companies.
